findings: Since Jun 2026 (24 Mon–Sun weeks): Meta spend vs organic halo revenue correlates weakly (lag-0 r≈0.39, lag-1 r≈0.01) — moves together sometimes, not lockstep.
Meta-attributed Shopify sales track halo better than spend alone (lag-0 r≈0.32). Good Meta weeks avg ~$4402.0 organic halo vs ~$4173.0 on bad weeks.
